title: [29x]- Warehouse shipment item tracking inherits the source line's stale pick bin on the Transfer and Purchase-Return branches, so a second partial shipment fails with "You cannot select more than 0 units"
summary: Warehouse shipment item tracking on Transfer and Purchase-Return branches no longer inherits stale pick bins, allowing subsequent partial shipments to process correctly without unit selection errors.
key_points: Fixed stale pick bin inheritance for warehouse shipment item tracking on Transfer Line-Reserve
Fixed stale pick bin inheritance for warehouse shipment item tracking on Purchase Line-Reserve
Extends previous fix that only covered the Sales branch to both Transfer and Purchase-Return branches
Prevents 'You cannot select more than 0 units' error on second partial shipment
Added test coverage for the warehouse pick scenario
quote: Warehouse shipment item tracking inherits the source line's stale pick bin on the Transfer and Purchase-Return branches
